notes.title: UPDATE 0.0.9.1
notes.content:
- kitchen revision
- new event
- new report system (F10) but can be assigned by yourself
- recalculation of shadows and lights
- basic framework, of the upper floor almost finished
- new blood and gore effects
- particle system completely reworked again
- The engine now works together with Discord, we get all user data about FPS and crashes directly as message
- Loadingscreen (Splash) revised.
- Complete translation to german finished.
- Adaptation of the "Power" system.
- Completely new soundtrack.
- Weather readjusted.
- Problems with saving and loading fixed.
- Workroom finished.
- Guest room completed.
- Problems in the pause menu fixed.
- New enemy texture added.
- AI reworked. 
- Minor adjustments and bugfixes.
